title: Registru viticol DEMO (grower -> parcel -> events)
description: Structure aligned with the EU vineyard register, Reg. (EU) 2018/273 art. 7 and annexes III-IV: grower identity, parcel identified through the land-parcel / cadastral system with GIS geometry, area, variety, planting year, authorisation, PDO/PGI and the history of plantings, grubbing-up and inspections. All values in registry/parcels_demo.geojson are SYNTHETIC (DEMO). Measured fields are added by pipeline/register.py from the drone survey (web/data/register.geojson).

grower_id.description: pseudonymised grower id (production: IDNO / IDNP via MPass, never shown on the map)

Measured.description: filled automatically from the pipeline outputs (EPSG:32635, horizontal)

measured_area_ha.description: row length inside the parcel x row spacing of the block

rows.description: distinct row_id with >= 2 m inside the parcel

row_spacing_m.description: median distance between neighbouring row axes of the block

density_nominal.description: vines/ha = 10000 / (row spacing x 1.2 m vine spacing)

status_detected.description: no_vines: measured area < 10 % of the parcel; abandoned (heuristic): vegetation inter-rows > 80 % and gap share > 40 %

rvv_code.description: Registrul Vitivinicol code; null = parcel not covered by a registration

vineyard_id.description: detected block the parcel was generated from (link to the map)

planting_scheme.description: row spacing x vine spacing, as declared

scenario.description: how the DEMO parcel was generated (test scenarios)
